risks.title: VPS accepts tactical records without the configured unique key
risks.consequence: Records without identity cannot be deduplicated reliably and may inflate tactical collections.
compensatingControls: SLF client contracts require snapshotKey, resultKey, eventKey, or effectKey
append responses report missingUniqueKey
analysis health reports missingUniqueKeys
contract and compatibility tests cover the current behaviour
risks.target: Reject missing tactical identity before persistence after producer compatibility verification and a separately tested deployment change.

risks.title: VPS API has no explicit request-body size limit
risks.consequence: Oversized authenticated requests can consume memory, CPU, and storage.
compensatingControls: API requires bearer authentication
CI fuzz payloads are bounded
deployment remains private operational infrastructure
risks.target: Introduce a reviewed MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH and negative tests with an explicit operational limit.

risks.title: VPS API CORS policy is broad
risks.consequence: Unexpected browser origins may attempt authenticated API access if a token is exposed to that origin.
compensatingControls: Bearer token is stored in Tampermonkey storage
token is sent only in the Authorization header
userscript connection hosts are allowlisted
risks.target: Define and test explicit allowed origins without breaking Tampermonkey transport.

risks.title: External jQuery userscript dependency is URL-versioned but not content-addressed
risks.consequence: A compromised external distribution path could change executed dependency bytes without a repository diff.
compensatingControls: The dependency URL is fixed to jQuery 3.6.0
The exact @require allowlist is merge-blocking
Release evidence records the declared external requirement
risks.target: Remove the dependency, vendor a reviewed licensed copy, or add content-digest verification to release evidence.

risks.title: Browser DOM XSS coverage is not yet sink-complete
risks.boundary: Untrusted page and API text to userscript UI
risks.consequence: An unsafe render path could execute or inject attacker-controlled markup in the SLF page context.
compensatingControls: Dynamic code execution sinks are prohibited
Browser E2E executes the exact artifact and fails on runtime exceptions
Security scan inventories innerHTML assignments
risks.target: Classify every innerHTML assignment and add malicious-string fixtures for all untrusted data paths.

risks.title: Component workflows are path-filtered and cannot safely be required individually
risks.consequence: A skipped path-filtered workflow can leave a required status context pending and block unrelated merges.
compensatingControls: All prerequisite quality workflows are integrated into main
The rollout manifest requires an always-running aggregate check before protection is enabled
Branch protection remains explicitly not enforced until the aggregate context is observed
risks.target: Create and observe the exact aggregate status context, then configure and verify branch protection with a disposable pull request.

risks.title: No independent reviewer is currently available for critical repository changes
risks.consequence: The same maintainer can author requirements, implementation, tests, and approval, increasing the chance that a shared mistaken assumption passes every internal check.
compensatingControls: Owner acceptance is recorded explicitly and never described as independent review
Exact artifact, contract, security, browser E2E, property, fuzz, mutation, reliability, and provenance gates are integrated
Critical unresolved assumptions must remain in the risk register with review dates
Production deployment and branch-protection changes require separate explicit owner actions
Failures and skipped checks cannot be silently reclassified as successful review
risks.target: Use an independent qualified reviewer when one becomes available and reassess whether approval requirements can be increased.
risks.acceptance: Repository owner explicitly accepted this single-maintainer risk on 2026-08-04.
